answer: Each agent identity locks a 100-token bond, so 1,000 sybils cost the attacker 100,000 tokens frozen for a 30-day horizon. That capital can't be reused, and any detected collusion slashes it, making bulk fakes unprofitable. Bots that wander between peers to dodge accountability never build the slow reputation score that peaks at a zenith, so fresh identities stay worthless next to aged bonded ones.
